name: trailing-pipe
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[1 2 3] |"
  :marker "         ^"
  :message "`|` joins two steps, and the step after it is missing"
  :expected [:whitespace]
  :location ::span[9 1 10 9 1 10]
} | raise

name: double-pipe
a-pipe-after-the-catch-keeps-the-catch
expect: "`|` written after `!|` is the habit of a pipe before every step: write `a !| b`"

name: a-catch-after-the-catch-stands-once
expect: "`!|` written after `!|`: a combinator stands once between two steps, write `a !| b`"

name: a-comment-opener-against-a-pipe-names-the-verb-that-runs-code
expect: "`|~` opens a comment that is never closed; code runs on the value in the pipe by a verb, `| apply ~(…)`"

name: a-declaration-on-the-fail-track-ends-the-head
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| ~(query /0 1) ::number | impl ~(!| :k 2 | add n)) | 5 | m

name: a-combinator-before-a-closing-bracket-names-the-step-it-misses
expect: "`|` joins two steps, and the step after it is missing"

name: a-combinator-after-a-piped-catch-is-refused-as-after-a-catch
expect: "`|` written after `!|` is the habit of a pipe before every step: write `a !| b`"

name: a-pipe-after-the-catch-at-the-head-is-refused-as-the-habit
